evidence.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine / FDA
evidence.title: Lisinopril - Indications & Usage
evidence.text:
Drug: Lisinopril
Section: Indications & Usage

Lisinopril is indicated for the treatment of hypertension in adults and children >= 6 years; adjunct therapy in heart failure; acute myocardial infarction within 24 hours.

evidence.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine / FDA
evidence.title: Atorvastatin - Indications & Usage
evidence.text:
Drug: Atorvastatin
Section: Indications & Usage

Adjunct to diet for primary hyperlipidemia, hypertriglyceridemia, prevention of cardiovascular disease (MI, stroke, revascularization) in patients at risk.

evidence.source_name: Indian Council of Medical Research Clinical Guidelines
evidence.publisher: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR, Govt of India)
evidence.title: ICMR Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management of Hypertension in India - Diagnosis and Screening Protocol in Indian Primary Care
evidence.section: Diagnosis and Screening Protocol in Indian Primary Care
evidence.text:
ICMR Clinical Guideline: ICMR Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management of Hypertension in India (2020)
Issuing Body: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR, Govt of India)
Section: Diagnosis and Screening Protocol in Indian Primary Care (Page 8)

Hypertension is defined as persistent Office Blood Pressure of Systolic BP >= 140 mmHg and/or Diastolic BP >= 90 mmHg based on the average of at least two seated readings taken on two separate clinical visits. Universal screening is recommended for all Indian adults >= 18 years visiting primary healthcare facilities.
